### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Default: **as above**. WB = `SNAP_WB_REF4`, XC = `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT`, FC = `SNAP_FLUX_COVARIANCE`,
MC = `SNAP_X1_MASS_COVARIANCE`, RE = `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT`.
XC implies WB. `<b>` is the build suffix, normally `release`.
“child” means a script creates fresh processes; “CTest” means the registration sets the variable.
Unspecified flags must be sanitized when reproducing a row. The table lists selected evidence, not every test in the project.
:::

| combination | work / grid | registered evidence | meaning |

| RE 0/1 (child) | face; tall column | `test_implicit_gravity_tall_column_python` | implicit rest comparison |

### Derivation

Coverage is a relation between a configuration and a test assertion, not a probability or an accuracy estimate.
A row is supported only when both the registration and the test's actual arm agree. A guard assertion supports
setup behavior; it does not support an error norm. The anchor audit checks these sources without executing them.

### Numerical method

First select a build that contains the required entries, then establish import provenance, sanitize scheme variables,
and launch the named arm. Compare the invariant selected by the gravity-work mode. Record CPU/CUDA and rank count
with every measured result. The dependency figure shows logical constraints rather than measured performance.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch12-matrix-flow
#| fig-cap: "Logical dependencies: labelled arrows mean implies, requires, or acts only with. The diagram is not a sequence of numerical operations."
#| fig-alt: "XC implies WB; WB + gravity: 3 ghosts; MC + gravity: 3 owned cells; RE + face + supported grid; FC: per-direction source."
#| echo: false

make_fig()
```

### Limits

New evidence is needed for numerical MC behavior; XC with face work/RE; XC+FC; WB/XC on gnomonic grids;
WB with RE=0 under face work; FC across MPI ranks; and broader simultaneous study-switch combinations.
WB+FC+RE has a registered order oracle. All-flags combinations are not thereby covered.

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
